credit_metrics.text: EBITDA rose by {{ebitda.change@FY2024}} to {{ebitda@FY2024}}, but operating profit fell by {{operating_profit.change@FY2024}} to {{operating_profit@FY2024}} as depreciation, amortisation and impairment increased by {{dda.change@FY2024}} to {{dda@FY2024}}.

Total debt increased by {{total_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{total_debt@FY2024}} and net debt by {{net_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{net_debt@FY2024}}, leaving gross leverage broadly unchanged at {{gross_leverage@FY2024}}.
Interest coverage weakened to {{interest_coverage@FY2024}} as finance costs rose by {{finance_costs.change@FY2024}} to {{finance_costs@FY2024}}.

Cash generation improved: FFO rose by {{ffo.change@FY2024}} to {{ffo@FY2024}} and free cash flow by {{fcf.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf@FY2024}}, although FFO to debt eased by {{ffo_to_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{ffo_to_debt@FY2024}} as debt grew.

FCF to debt improved by {{fcf_to_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_to_debt@FY2024}}, with capex intensity rising by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2024}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2024}} as capital spending increased by {{capex.change@FY2024}} to {{capex@FY2024}}.

liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments rose by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}, taking cash liquidity to revenue down to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}} as revenue grew faster than the cash balance.

Advance ticket cover rose by {{advance_ticket_cover.change@FY2024}} to {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2024}}, with contract liabilities up by {{contract_liabilities.change@FY2024}} to {{contract_liabilities@FY2024}}, so a larger part of the cash balance is customers' prepayments.
Financing terms for upcoming aircraft deliveries improved, with the company securing its best-ever terms for part of its order book.
The Board intends to propose a profit distribution per share for the year, subject to approval from debt instrument holders.

operating_performance.text: Passengers rose by {{passengers.change@FY2024}} to {{passengers@FY2024}}, supported by the Widerøe acquisition completed at the start of the year.

Fuel cost increased by {{fuel_cost.change@FY2024}} to {{fuel_cost@FY2024}}, while the fuel share of costs fell by {{fuel_share_of_costs.change@FY2024}} to {{fuel_share_of_costs@FY2024}} as revenue grew faster than fuel spending.
The operating result was held back by the weakening of the Norwegian krone against the US dollar and by external disruptions during the year.
Collective bargaining agreements concluded during the year raised personnel cost across several markets while reducing the risk of industrial action.

peer_positioning.text: Norwegian has the lowest gross leverage of the low-cost group ({{gross_leverage.peer_rank@FY2024}}) and the strongest FCF to debt ({{fcf_to_debt.peer_rank@FY2024}}), at {{fcf_to_debt@FY2024}} against a peer median of {{fcf_to_debt.peer_median@FY2024}}.

Cash liquidity to revenue is the weakest of the group ({{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_rank@FY2024}}), at {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}} against a peer median of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_median@FY2024}}.

On EBITDA margin, net leverage, interest coverage and FFO to debt the company sits in the middle of the group, and its advance ticket cover of {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2024}} is the lowest of the peers ({{advance_ticket_cover.peer_rank@FY2024}}).

snapshot.text: Norwegian Air Shuttle, the Norwegian low-cost carrier, grew revenue by {{revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{revenue@FY2024}} in FY2024, a year in which the acquisition of Widerøe was finalised and delivery delays from Boeing constrained fleet growth.
The EBITDA margin narrowed by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2024}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2024}}, while net leverage was broadly unchanged at {{net_leverage@FY2024}}.

The point to watch is cash liquidity, which fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}} of revenue, the weakest of the low-cost peer group ({{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_rank@FY2024}}).

watch_items.text: Liquidity: cash liquidity to revenue fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}, below the peer median of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_median@FY2024}}.
Margins: the EBITDA margin narrowed by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2024}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2024}}, with operating profit down {{operating_profit.change@FY2024}} as depreciation rose.
Debt service: interest coverage eased by {{interest_coverage.change@FY2024}} to {{interest_coverage@FY2024}} as finance costs rose by {{finance_costs.change@FY2024}}.
Customer prepayments: advance ticket cover rose by {{advance_ticket_cover.change@FY2024}} to {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2024}}, so a larger share of the cash balance is refundable if bookings slow.
